mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_account (account_id, realm, account_type, login_name, email_vault_token, email_masked, email_verified_time, status, consecutive_password_failures, locked_until, last_password_failure_time, credential_version, auth_epoch, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, 'CUSTOMER', 'HUMAN', NULL, #{token}, #{masked}, NULL, 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 0, NULL, NULL, 1, 1, 1, #{now}, #{now})

mapper.update: UPDATE t_authentication_challenge SET status='SUPERSEDED', active_slot=NULL, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE challenge_id=#{id} AND realm='CUSTOMER' AND status='PENDING' AND active_slot=1 AND version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_authentication_challenge (challenge_id, challenge_no, realm, purpose, account_id, tenant_invitation_id, email_vault_token, email_masked, active_scope_hash, secret_hmac, hmac_key_version, expires_time, max_attempts, used_attempts, status, active_slot, consumed_time, supersedes_challenge_id, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{challenge.id}, #{challenge.challengeNo}, 'CUSTOMER', #{challenge.purpose}, #{challenge.accountId}, NULL, #{challenge.emailToken}, #{challenge.emailMasked}, #{challenge.scopeHash}, #{challenge.secretHmac}, #{challenge.keyVersion}, #{challenge.expiresTime}, 5, 0, 'PENDING', 1, NULL, #{challenge.supersedesId}, 1, #{challenge.createTime}, #{challenge.createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_authentication_challenge SET status='CONSUMED', active_slot=NULL, consumed_time=#{now}, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE challenge_id=#{id} AND realm='CUSTOMER' AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING' AND active_slot=1 AND expires_time>#{now} AND max_attempts=5 AND used_attempts<max_attempts

UPDATE t_authentication_challenge SET status=CASE WHEN expires_time<=#{now} THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN used_attempts+1>=max_attempts THEN 'REVOKED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, active_slot=CASE WHEN expires_time<=#{now} OR used_attempts+1>=max_attempts THEN NULL ELSE 1 END, used_attempts=LEAST(used_attempts+1,max_attempts), version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE challenge_id=#{id} AND realm='CUSTOMER' AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING' AND active_slot=1
